ns2:course.label: Intro to Research Methods
ns2:course.description: Introduction to quantitative and qualitative research methods used to study human development and families. Provides experience conducting observations and survey interviews, evaluating research results, and writing research reports. Prerequisite: HDFS 105.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Human Development & Family St major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
